messages:
Maya Chen: heads up — p95/p99 for hosted-api spiked after the 09:01 deploy, seeing ~220ms -> ~450ms p99 on gen endpoints
Samir Patel: alerted. queue depth on runtime nodes jumped, but GPU util and host CPU look normal so far
Li Wei: grabbed a perf trace on a noisy host — lots of time in kvcache::prefetch_latch_wait (~80-140ms), stacks show repeated kernel switch ops during batch spin
ops-bot: deployment noticed: ryang/edge-prefetch-intel abc123 deployed at 09:01 (canary -> prod)
Maya Chen: that commit turned on sampler speculative-prefetch with aggressive prefetch window, could be hammering kvcache locks
Samir Patel: also seeing more kernel selector churn (fallback path chosen mid-request) when sequence lengths vary. trace: flip from fast_attention_x86 -> fallback_scalar at token ~120
Li Wei: eBPF output (short):
```
clk: 09:04:15
kvcache_latch_wait  -> 120ms
kernel_switch_count -> 14 / req
batch_merge_retries -> 3
```
Samir Patel: quick hypothesis: speculative prefetch increases concurrent kvcache touch-set, held latch blocks batch coalescing -> queue buildup -> kernel selector hits degenerate path -> longer per-token
Sophia Ramos: can we repro on staging by toggling sampler window?
Maya Chen: staging run with small window disabled shows no spike (p99 stable). suggests sampler change is culprit
Ryan G: rolling a hotfix — disable speculative-prefetch flag in runtime config and scale up prefetch backoff to reduce contention. will canary to 2 nodes
Li Wei: guiding mitigation: 1) revert sampler flag; 2) increase kvcache latch timeout metrics and add hist for latch_hold_ms; 3) add kernel-switch counter per-request for alerting
Samir Patel: adding a short-term routing policy: route long-seq requests to dedicated pool where we keep fallback kernels warmed (reduces selector churn)
Maya Chen: noted. ops-bot, throttle alert noise for this alert group while we roll the canary
ops-bot: muting alerts for alert:runtime.p99_spike for 30m as requested by Maya Chen
Sophia Ramos: after hotfix canary (2 nodes) p99 dropped back to baseline on those nodes within 2min. starting gradual roll to remainder
Samir Patel: follow-ups: add regression test for sampler/kvcache interplay, and a perf test exercising kernel selector with variable seq-lengths. filing tickets
Maya Chen: thanks team. I'll update status page and post postmortem draft after rollout completes.
Samir Patel: also keep an eye on cost delta — speculative prefetch should save tokens long-run but not at the cost of tail latency
Li Wei: saving traces to /var/ci/artifacts/prefetch-latch/2076543210 and uploading flamegraph link: https://internal.srv/flames/2076543210
Maya Chen: closing thread when roll completes. :thumbsup:
